status: TP2 PP2 text serving validated on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs; qualification is limited to the checks below

donor.author: thecyberdevl <thecyberdevl@users.noreply.github.com>
donor.patch_6: Not reapplied: current upstream already copies pinned PLE rows as bytes.
donor.patches_7_through_29: Not yet ported or qualified. No donor throughput claims apply to this integration.

integration_changes: Adapt renamed QSA indexer and side-cache modules to current upstream.
Use model-dtype rounding in current upstream's fused QSA preparation kernel.
Distinguish FP16 KV storage from FP8 bytes in sparse attention dispatch and warmup.
Keep the BF16-only specialized FP8 decode path out of FP16 dispatch and warmup.
Limit the imported hardware launch profiles to SM75.
Carry the earlier RTX8000 branch's subgroup-aware peer checks and group-scoped cache initialization.
Add FP16 numerical coverage to existing QSA, indexer and hyper-connection tests.
Provide a TP2 PP2 launcher using upstream per-worker NUMA binding and measured FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs for batches 1 through 5.

checkpoint.conversion: none; original FP8 checkpoint, Marlin W8A16 execution

accumulation_policy: Existing kernel behavior retained; no global FP32 mandate introduced.

qualification.hardware: 4x Quadro RTX 8000, existing 200 W limits, NVLink pairs 0/1 and 2/3, two NUMA nodes
qualification.marlin_tp2_pp2: All four ranks passed at token counts 1, 5 and 17; maximum relative L2 error 0.002224
qualification.full_model_smoke: 4/4 exact answers in both eager and CUDA-graph modes
qualification.chunked_prefill: 3/3 exact retrievals in both modes at 998, 4064 and 7145 prompt tokens
qualification.benchmark: 26 prompt tokens, 128 output tokens, three repetitions at concurrency 1, 2 and 5, thinking and prefix caching disabled
qualification.limitations: Text only. Smoke and controlled performance checks, not broad accuracy or optimality evaluation. Simultaneous long-context requests, one/two-token MTP tuning, DFlash2 execution, multimodal inputs and alternative checkpoints remain unqualified.

long_context.retrieval: 12/12 passes per mode including warmups; keys at beginning, middle and end

timing.input: Exact-length token IDs from repository documentation in the official non-thinking chat template; keys at beginning, middle, end
timing.prefill_rate: Computed input tokens / request_prefill_time_seconds; scheduled-to-first-token service time, including chunk scheduling and pipeline overhead; not isolated kernel throughput
timing.ttft: Client request start to first nonempty streamed text
timing.decode_rate: 127 / request_decode_time_seconds; server first-to-last generation timing includes generated tokens with no visible text
timing.visible_text_stream_rate_caveat: The raw client metric divides 127 by first-to-last nonempty text arrival. It can overstate decode throughput when special tokens produce no text; the context table uses server decode time instead.
timing.scope: Repeated retrieval smoke test and performance measurements; not broad model-quality validation or concurrent long-context qualification

long_output_comparison.interpretation: All retrieval keys matched; some 64K explanation wording differed. The non-speculative baseline also varies across repeated identical prompts, so exact long-context greedy equivalence is not established and the variation cannot be attributed solely to MTP.

native_mtp.default: disabled; opt in with the documented speculative configuration
native_mtp.recommendation: Opt in for measured generation-latency benefit; keep baseline available for prefill-heavy or concurrent long-context workloads. Three draft tokens tested; one/two-token MTP tuning remains unmeasured.

Validate the draft's FP16 noncausal sliding-attention execution on SM75, followed by acceptance, quality and latency checks

measurement.prefill: One cold request per 32768/65536/131072 input tokens, 128 output tokens. Rate is input tokens divided by vLLM request prefill service time.
measurement.decode: Two repetitions after warmup: 8192 input, 768 output tokens, 1 or 5 users. Streamed token-ID counts in the common interval after every prefill and before any completion, trimmed 0.5s at each edge.
measurement.whole_request: Total output tokens divided by client wall time, including all prefills.
measurement.profile: Separate captures excluded from timing. Rank-local GPU duration sums can include overlap and synchronization waits.
measurement.quality: Three exact retrievals per variant and 8184 fixed teacher-forced tokens; not broad accuracy or bitwise speculative equivalence.

prefill_graph_and_gdn_followup.graph_decision: Retain eager prefill/full decode graphs: neither coarse nor31-size fine breakable prefill capture improved long-prefill throughput, and both increased five-user last-first-token latency from~10s to~14s. Mixed-prefill regression cause remains unresolved; this does not disprove future graph optimization or graph+larger-custom-collective combinations.

benchmarks.timing: Five CUDA-event samples, ten replays/sample; median eager and graph milliseconds. Existing T64 autotuning happens once before timing. No CPU compile or other GPU jobs overlapped accepted timing intervals.

native_variant_decision.reason: Retain query16: the small query32 gains at T1024/T2048 did not remain consistent under reversed ordering; query32 materially regressed for N5/T512. N1/T512 had a repeatable approximately 7 microsecond gain, insufficient to justify a special dispatch rule in this task.
native_variant_decision.invalid_samples: All GPU1 graph timings in the AB/BA repeat are INVALID empty captures from a cached GPU0 default capture stream and are excluded. GPU0 eager/graph and GPU1 eager measurements remain valid. The standalone repeat harness now uses an explicit per-device capture stream; no corrected GPU1 graph rerun is claimed.
native_variant_decision.clock_observation: GPU0 SM clocks approximately1905-1980MHz; GPU1 remained1620MHz. Both memory clocks6500MHz and power limits200W. No clock settings were changed; cause of the difference was not established.
native_variant_decision.harness_provenance: The explicit per-device stream correction and formatting changes occurred AFTER the recorded AB/BA run. The currently saved harness was not the script revision executed for that artifact; its current SHA must not be attributed to the past run. An executed-harness SHA was not recorded. The main 150-row native benchmark ran entirely on GPU0 and is unaffected.

marlin_tile_and_shared_memory_qualificat.aggregation: Pool raw CUDA-event samples across available orders for each identical capture/stage/config/GPU; select lowest median among configs passing all baseline orders. At least two orders are required for the repeated-direction flag; one-order screening remains provisional. Eager is the relevant prefill mode; graph is the relevant decode/verifier mode. Per-order results expose instability; they are not statistical confidence intervals.
marlin_tile_and_shared_memory_qualificat.user_count_note: actual_m_rows is a captured matrix dimension, not concurrent-user count. Five-user base and MTP requests may execute several microbatches. Report each actual capture separately; do not sum its isolated rates into user throughput.

m8_caveat.explanation: Host accounting retains M16 metadata and A sizes for M8. This is a safe conservative bound, not minimal allocation or relocation of the kernel's metadata offset.
m8_caveat.action: Clarify the M8 alignment comment; communicated to the implementation agent

alignment_and_overlays: All shared pointers are int4-aligned; M8's actual 128-byte metadata offset remains suitably aligned.
B and reduction storage share a base. Bias is placed at min(B,reduction), and the arena reserves max(B,reduction,min(B,reduction)+bias).
The inter-warp FP32 reduction fits the B/reduction arena for the existing four tile configurations, including cases where its footprint exceeds the named output-reduction region.
Bias fetch follows inter-warp reduction; bias is moved into registers before the final output shuffle overwrites the shared reduction arena.
SM75 copy helpers are synchronous int4 loads/stores, with no additional cp.async allocation requirement.
CUDA occupancy queries account for hardware allocation granularity, registers, static shared memory, and reserved shared memory; the old 1536-byte occupancy estimate is not an allocation requirement.

workspace_reasoning.fp32_allocation: min(N*sorted_token_ids_length, SMs*4*moe_block_size*max_tile_N) FP32 elements, doubled for M8
workspace_reasoning.kernel_slot: rounded_M * tile_N FP32 elements for each locks_off slot
workspace_reasoning.m8: The doubling covers 16-row kernel slots despite 8-row routed blocks
workspace_reasoning.locks: Existing allocation bounds the slots by min(global MN tiles, SMs*4); the new path enforces1<=blocks_per_sm<=4

collective_conclusion.reasoning: The real1600-token prefill capture uses custom FP16 TP2 reductions below the unchanged8MiB limit. PP SendRecv, AllGather and uint8 AllReduce remain NCCL operations; no claim that NCCL disappears entirely.
collective_conclusion.payload_limit: Collective tensor bytes are source-derived from the observed token count and model width, not a profiler payload measurement.
collective_conclusion.timing_limit: Rank-local collective durations include synchronization waits and overlap; they do not isolate link bandwidth or prove customAR faster than NCCL at the same size.

measurement_context.evidence: All ranks have identical1600-token prefill annotations; launch.json retains the8MiB customAR cutoff.
measurement_context.comparison_limit: The previous no-MTP2048-token capture differs in both row count and MTP work; do not interpret raw kernel-time differences as a matched performance A/B.

remaining_cutoff_cases.note: Larger mixed/padded steps can still exceed8MiB. No cutoff increase is required for the common1600-row path observed here.

limitations: One cold-prefill observation per context and two decode repetitions; differences are observations, not confidence intervals.
Decode uses8192 input/768 output tokens; long-prefill tests use32768/65536/131072 input and128 output tokens.
Five simultaneous128K requests and natural LRU eviction have not been qualified.
Retrieval and8184-token likelihood diagnostics do not establish broad quality or bitwise speculative equivalence.
Native GDN state is prefill chunk recurrence; recurrent decode kernels are unchanged.
Marlin synchronization qualification covers guarded companion M16/M32 at the selected geometry, not every stock MoE shape or format.
Gate/up activation fusion is experimental and disabled after full-layer regressions.
Companion extensions were rebuilt independently; no full wheel or other-architecture qualification.

power225_comparison.scope: Prior completed 200 W runs, same benchmark and prompt hashes; not a randomized interleaved power trial.

quality_at225.scope: Fixed repository-text teacher-forced diagnostic; not broad model accuracy or proof of speculative equivalence.

limits: One cold observation per long context and two decode repetitions; not confidence intervals.
Telemetry spans load, warmup, timing and profiling; busy means GPU utilization at least80%, not a phase-isolated energy benchmark.
